events.text: The test expects FIN-12 rounding (half up to the cent), but `tax()` uses `math.floor`, which gives 10.12. The test is correct, so I'll fix the source.

I fixed the bug in `src/invoice.py`, not the test. I haven't run the suite, so CI is the first real check.

**Cause:** `tax()` used `math.floor`, which truncates. `112.50 × 0.09 = 10.125`, which floors to 10.12. Finance policy FIN-12 requires rounding half up, which gives 10.13.

**Change:** `tax()` now uses `Decimal` with `ROUND_HALF_UP` to the cent. I used `Decimal(str(...))` to avoid float artifacts such as `10.125` being stored as `10.12499...`. It still returns a float, so existing callers keep their type.

**Risk:** Every invoice tax calculation changes from floor to half-up. Any other test or stored expectation that relied on truncation will now fail. The repo has only this one test file, so I couldn't check other callers.
